parole.significato: to here, hither, (often in practice, in translations) here
parole.testo: From Old Swedish hit, from *hī+at. * hī, from Proto-Indo-European *kei- (as in Ancient Greek ἐκεῖ (ekeî)) * at, from Proto-Germanic *at, from Proto-Indo-European *ád (as in Swedish åt) Composed in a similar way: Icelandic hegat and hingað.

parole.significato: lye (a strong caustic alkaline solution of potassium or sodium salts)
parole.testo: Ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *lewh₃- (“to bathe, wash”); compare Proto-Germanic *lauþrą (“lather, foam”) and *laugō (“lye, soap”).
